premises.title: Fired For A 'Non-Essential' License, I Watched Their Audit Collapse
premises.premise: A licensed compliance engineer is cut as 'non-essential' weeks before the audit that legally requires his signature.

premises.title: My Manager Took Credit For My Patent Filing
premises.premise: A manager claims an engineer's invention in a promotion review, not knowing the patent office already has the engineer's dated lab notebook.

premises.title: HR Denied My Overtime, So I Followed The Policy Exactly
premises.premise: An IT lead is told to stop logging overtime and follows the written on-call policy to the letter during the company's biggest outage.
